title.narrative: Danish contribution to OECD Task Force on Mobilising Private Sector Finance for Development, Climate and Biodiversity

description.narrative: Danish contribution to OECD Task Force on Mobilising Private Sector Finance for Development, Climate and Biodiversity in line with the outcomes of the Summit for a New Global Financing Pact (NFP) including the "Paris Pact for People and the Planet". The task force will provide interested OECD Members and the Secretariat with an opportunity to convene to discuss how to mobilise private sector finance for development, climate and biodiversity in a cross-sectoral, cross disciplinary way. It is estimated that two task force meetings would be held per year. The full budget for the task force meetings would be 100.000 EUR, of which Denmark would supply 30.000 EUR (budget outlined in attached OECD note)
